The Japanese guys I've known haven't had Disney-like ideas that marriage is supposed to be bathed in "true love" and monogamous WRT sex. A guy goes into the office in the morning, does activities to keep the company running, then comes home and does activities to keep the household running. I've seen Japanese couples act exactly like coworkers. No Disney there, and no sexual interest that I can discern.

And if they start to get that itch that needs to be scratched, most Japanese guys don't get all kinds of American-style angst and guilt and beat themselves up. they scratch the itch, enjoy their time with a girl they've either picked up or paid for, then get back on the job at home.
